title: Administrator / Legal Secretary Re-train Opportunity
description:
Job Title: Legal Secretary Re-train Opportunity

Location: Sharston, M22 4 SN

Salary: £28,000 Per annum

Job type: Full time, Permanent

Established in 2000, Express Solicitors is an award-winning, no win no fee law firm specialising exclusively in personal injury claims. Headquartered in Manchester, we support clients nationwide across all areas of personal injury, including employers' liability, serious injury, clinical negligence, occupiers' and public liability, road traffic accidents and industrial disease.

We are ranked 60th in The Lawyer UK Top 200, out of more than 10,000 law firms nationwide, and after achieving a 24% year-on-year growth, Express Solicitors are the largest personal injury claimant firm in the UK.

Our commitment to outstanding client care is reflected in our Trustpilot rating of 4.7 (Excellent), placing us among the highest-rated firms in the sector.

About The Role:

We are currently looking for strong administrators ideally with a minimum of two years administration experience. Background in legal and medical advantageous

Following extensive training you will be working in a pool of Legal Secretaries assisting a number of Lawyers. The job is varied with not just typing and file management, but preparing bundles, taking and making calls to clients, arranging meetings & conferences.

Responsibilities
- Working collaboratively within a pool of Legal Secretaries to support multiple Lawyers
- You will be working in one stream of work either Road Traffic Accidents, Employers' Liability or Occupiers & Public Liability.
- Preparing correspondence and legal documentation, including pleadings and court bundles
- Photocopying and scanning documents, with support from the Administration team where required
- Handling inbound and outbound telephone calls in a professional and courteous manner
- Scheduling appointments, arranging meetings, and liaising with Lawyers, clients, Counsel, and other stakeholders
- Providing support to fellow Legal Secretaries and the wider administration team as required
- Assisting with updates to the Proclaim case management system where appropriate

Person Specification:
- Demonstrable two years previous administration experience, background in legal and medical advantageous.
- Strong comprehension of English spelling, punctuation, and grammar.
- IT literate
- Exceptional customer service skills, including professional and friendly telephone manner.
- Acute attention to detail
- Ability to prioritise daily workload and experience of working in a fast-paced environment.
- Prior exposure to Proclaim case management system is desirable.
- Excellent word processing and audio typing skills
- Audio typing speed of 65+ words per minute
- Use of digital dictation, ideally Diktamen would be beneficial.

Salary & Hours
- A basic salary of up to £28,000
- Our standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:30pm Monday-Thursday and 8:30am to 5pm Friday.

Benefits:
- Hybrid Working - 3/2 hybrid working pattern after probation.
- 23 Days Holiday - Rising to 26 days, plus bank/public holidays.
- Extra Holidays - 3 holiday buy backs and an extra day for your birthday after service length requirement.
- Looking After Your Health - Private medical insurance available after 2 years' service, annual flu jab and Employee Assistance Programme.
- Looking After Your Well-being - 24/7 onsite Gym, Netball/Football team, 10km Manchester team and more.
- Work Life / Balance - Active social committee with generous departmental and firm-wide social budget.

Recruitment Process:

Interviews will be conducted by MS Teams and will include scenario-based questioning.

Our employees are our most important asset, we rate skill and ability above all else and our recruitment policy encourages applications from all.

Please click APPLY to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

Candidates with the relevant experience or job titles of; Legal Secretary, PA, Legal Typist, Typist, Legal PA, Secretary, Legal Administrator, Legal Office Support, Legal Assistant, Legal Business Support, Office Administrator, Business Support Admin Assistant may also be considered For This Role.

title: Costs Legal Secretary
description:
Job Title: Costs Legal Secretary

Location: Northenden, M22 4 HH

Salary: Up to £28,000 per annum, dependent on experience

Job type: Full time, Permanent

Established in 2000, Express Solicitors is an award-winning, no win no fee law firm specialising exclusively in personal injury claims. Headquartered in Manchester, we support clients nationwide across all areas of personal injury, including employers' liability, serious injury, clinical negligence, occupiers' and public liability, road traffic accidents and industrial disease.

About The Role:

You will play key role as an experienced Legal Secretary supporting the Costs Department in servicing the costs needs of the business. You will be required to work independently servicing volume instructions from a digital dictation platform, this will include the creation of letters, witness statements, bundling of exhibits, file notes and other court documents, including court bundles.

Many of the documents and communications required will be prepared in digital format using complimentary software. Some paper documents, for postal delivery, remain necessary.

Whilst this is a busy role, it is varied and rewarding. In addition to typing and file management, you will assist with consulting with clients, third parties and the Court regularly by telephone, assisting with printing jobs and from time to time may be required to organise meetings and conferences.

You will join a team of experienced assistants, and secretaries who will provide you with training and support as you transition into the role.

Responsibilities:
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to Partners, Associates, Costs Lawyers, Costs Negotiators, and other members of the Costs Team.
- Preparing, formatting, proofreading, and amending legal costs documents, preparing digital and paper bundles, correspondence, and court forms.
- Managing diaries, arranging meetings and appointments.
- Opening and closing client files in accordance with firm procedures and regulatory requirements.
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, barristers, court staff, and external stakeholders in a professional manner.
- Handling emails and telephone enquiries, ensuring matters are directed appropriately and dealt with promptly.
- Assisting with the preparation and filing of court documents, including electronic filing where required.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring all case management systems and databases are updated.
- Organising and preparing bundles, exhibits, and supporting documentation for hearings, assessments, and negotiations.
- Monitoring key dates, court deadlines, and limitation periods.
- Audio typing of legal documents, correspondence and reports.
- Assisting with billing administration, file reviews, and matter management processes as required.
- Requesting and collating documents, records, invoices, and supporting evidence for costs claims and assessments.
- Ensuring compliance with firm policies, confidentiality requirements, data protection legislation, and court rules.
- Providing general administrative support including document scanning, photocopying, filing, archiving, and document management.
- Supporting the team with ad hoc projects and administrative tasks to ensure the efficient operation of our Legal Costs department.

Person Specification:
- Proven experience as a Legal Secretary in a busy team is essential
- Excellent written English skills, with strong spelling, punctuation, and grammar
- High level of IT literacy and confidence using modern office systems
- Outstanding client care skills, with a professional and friendly telephone manner
- Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail
- Ability to prioritise workload effectively and thrive in a fast-paced environment
- Previous experience using the Proclaim case management system is desirable but not essential
- Advanced word processing and audio typing skills
- Audio typing speed of 65+ words per minute
- Experience using digital dictation software, ideally Diktamen, would be advantageous

Salary & Hours
- Our standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:30pm Monday-Thursday and 8:30am to 5pm Friday.

Benefits:
- Hybrid Working - 3/2 hybrid working pattern after probation.
- 23 Days Holiday - Rising to 26 days, plus bank/public holidays.
- Extra Holidays - 3 holiday buy backs and an extra day for your birthday after service length requirement.
- Looking After Your Health - Private medical insurance available after 2 years' service, annual flu jab and Employee Assistance Programme.
- Looking After Your Well-being - 24/7 onsite Gym, Netball/Football team, 10km Manchester team and more.
- Work Life / Balance - Active social committee with generous departmental and firm-wide social budget.

Recruitment Process:

Interviews will be conducted by MS Teams and will include scenario-based questioning.

Our employees are our most important asset, we rate skill and ability above all else and our recruitment policy encourages applications from all.

title: Data Claims Caseworker Paralegal
description:
Duncan Lewis Solicitors:

Regulated by the Solicitor's Regulation Authority, Duncan Lewis Solicitors was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in the City of London (Fenchurch Street EC3 M), with offices nationwide. We are recognised by the Legal 500 and Chambers & Partners UK independent legal directories as a top-tier law firm in all of our key practice areas - "a diligent and professional team that is prepared to go the extra mile for its clients". A paperless law firm with over 500 personnel that embraces hybrid-working, we service both corporate entities and private individuals in over 25 areas of law across 60 languages. We give people a voice - that is our ethos.

Recognised among The Times 200 Best Law Firms, we have been awarded Law Firm of the Year at the 2024 Lexis Nexis Awards and 2023 Modern Law Awards, reflecting our dedication to legal expertise and client service. We hold Investors in People Gold Standard accreditation for over 15 years, showcasing our commitment to professional development. Duncan Lewis is also Law Society Lexcel, Cyber Essentials Plus, and ISO 27001 certified, ensuring excellence in practice management and data security.

About the Role:

Duncan Lewis Solicitors is seeking a talented and motivated Data Claims Caseworker Paralegal to join its highly regarded Data Claims Department.

The successful candidate will primarily be responsible for the New Client Diary and case set-up/onboarding as well as assistant casework support to the other lawyers in the department. You will be involved with speaking/communicating with new clients and, as part of that role, will be expected to obtain all relevant evidence from them ahead of case opening.

The successful candidate will preferably have prior experience with Data Claims work or at least an interest in data protection, privacy rights as well as unlawful processing/disclosure/retention/misuse of personal data.

Duties and responsibilities
- Reporting directly to the Departmental Director
- Communicating/liaising with new and existing clients by taking initial instructions and obtaining evidence in support of their claims.
- Creating files and preparing all necessary documentation for client onboarding.
- Assisting with casework support from other lawyers in the department.
- Maintaining accurate case records and ensuring compliance with the firm's quality and regulatory standards.
- Managing time recording and file administration effectively.
- Supporting departmental business development and marketing initiatives where required.
- Undertaking any other reasonable duties as directed by Management.

Experience and qualifications
- Minimum one-year of Caseworker Paralegal experience within a law firm/litigation environment.
- Experience with Data Claims work is preferable.
- Interest in dealing with claims involving the UK GDPR 2018, Data Protection Act 2018, privacy rights and misuse of private information is highly desirable.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage time effectively.
- Strong analytical and drafting skills.
- Excellent communication and client care skills.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Strong administration and file management skills.
- Experience handling client enquiries, maintaining accurate records and preparing/managing documentation.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively under pressure.
- Experience using case management systems and Microsoft Office applications.

Benefits

The Company offers competitive salaries and recognises the need to retain and reward its employees through both non-financial lifestyle rewards and financial benefits. The company operates a pay review policy, available to all staff, that sets out clearly salary review procedures available upon meeting performance targets. Our approach to rewards and benefits includes:
- Clear salary review procedures
- Automatic enrolment on to the company's pension scheme.
- 22 days annual leave which increases with length of service
- Additional birthday leave
- 7 days paid occupational sick pay
- Full payment towards annual renewal of Practising Certificate (SRA, CILEX)
- Full payment of Law Society Registration Fee for Panel Membership
- Full payment of Panel membership courses mandatory for Law Society Accreditation
- Individual access to company's e-library resources and training webinar library
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
- Wellbeing support - Mental Health First Aiders available
- Employee Referral/Introduction Scheme
- Eyesight test vouchers
- Maternity gift/vouchers
- Full payment of employment related DBS checks
- Temporary working from abroad (in exceptional circumstances)
- Part-time working considered
- Flexible working arrangements considered, such as Hybrid-Working and Compressed Hours
- Internal training contract intake - apply to train as a solicitor as authorised by the SRA and delivery of training. Successful retention, where appropriate and in accordance with business need, as a newly qualified solicitor
- Support for SQE1 exams
- Clear promotional opportunities (to Supervisor or Director) subject to business needs.
- Company support in becoming more prominent in field of practice through national industry award nominations, national legal directory submissions, media appearances and press releases.
- Enrolment on to Company Medical Cash Plan

subject to terms and conditions.

Company culture

At Duncan Lewis, we are committed to excellence, diversity, and social justice. Our teams work on matters that have a genuine impact on people's lives, often representing vulnerable individuals and holding public bodies to account through expert legal representation.

We foster an inclusive and collaborative working environment where talent is recognised, professional development is encouraged, and employees are supported to achieve their full potential. With award-winning training, clear progression pathways, and a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion, Duncan Lewis offers an exceptional platform for building a successful legal career.

Join a firm where your contribution matters and where you can help give people a voice.

- Audio Typing: Proficiently transcribing audio recordings using a Philips dictaphone machine and foot pedal.
- Document Management: Photocopying and filing important legal documents with precision and care.
- Communication: Answering phone calls, taking messages, and ensuring smooth communication between clients and legal professionals.
- Administrative Support: Assisting with various administrative tasks as needed to ensure the office operates efficiently.

What Our Client Is Looking For:

To be considered for this role, candidates should possess:
- Experience in Criminal Law: A solid background in criminal law is essential to navigate the unique challenges of this sector effectively.
- Audio Typing Skills: Strong proficiency in audio typing, particularly with the Philips dictaphone machine, is required.
- Organisational Abilities: Exceptional organisational skills to manage documents and tasks efficiently.
- Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to liaise effectively with clients and colleagues.
- Immediate Availability: The organisation is looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, so timely availability is crucial.

If you are an experienced Legal Secretary with a passion for criminal law and are available for immediate placement, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
